incident_strands: Establish the regression and affected traffic
result.comparison_plan: Read dashboards around the deployment and alert. Separate routes and identifiable traffic sources, including any scheduled or synthetic traffic. Compare latency, volume and timeout/error rates for equivalent request classes before and after deployment. Report whether the apparent regression survives that comparison and which users or workloads are affected.
result.diagnostic_report: Return observed failure signatures and request paths, evidence links or timestamps, the leading explanations with supporting and conflicting observations, and any telemetry gaps. Distinguish a timeout from a slow successful request. Recommend the next step only as far as the evidence supports.
result.mitigation_frame: Compare options after the initial telemetry review
